channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan attempts to revive an American industrial icon
item.description: For years, the Edgar Thomson steel mill was a symbol of faded American industrial power. Today it is being jolted back to life by Japan's Nippon Steel.

item.title: Honda and Toyota recall 1.6 million vehicles over Takata airbag rupture risk
item.description: Honda and Toyota both said ​there were no injuries or crashes tied to the vehicles being recalled, and there have ‌been no airbag ‌inflator ruptures

item.title: Tokyo is being reshaped by a historic real estate boom
item.description: Rents are heating up across Tokyo, particularly in the historically industrial, working-class east side.

item.title: AI-fueled cyberattacks drive claims surge at Japan insurers
item.description: Major property insurers are reporting a sharp jump in cyber insurance claims as artificial intelligence-driven hacking incidents surge nationwide.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
